children: Malayan Banking's ROE may decline as falling bond yields help rebuild its reserves, increasing its equity base, Affin Hwang IB analyst Chin Jin Han says in a note. Dilution from its dividend reinvestment plan may also weigh on returns, although loan growth, active loan repricing and funding cost management should support earnings, he says. Net interest margin pressure may persist amid domestic deposit competition but continued fee income growth is expected to cushion the impact, he adds. Affin Hwang cuts Maybank's target price to 12.00 ringgit from 12.25 ringgit, while maintaining a buy rating. Shares are 0.6% lower at 10.08 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
